scope: Public demonstration covering QSVT arXiv v1 and ContourSim25 arXiv v3 and v4. Publisher texts and other versions are outside this snapshot. Source headers are recorded and independent proof-audit and scientific-review attestations are unavailable here.

claims.summary: The inner construction uses a phase-bearing preparation and its own adjoint around the selector.
The revised inner construction uses distinct left and right preparations to retain complex coefficient phases.
